literal: Intimacy, that which is called, what if asked: in any way privilege not-rejecting friendship.
translation: If asked what is called true intimacy, it is the friendship that never rejects the liberties taken by a friend.
modern: பழைமை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எது என்றால், நண்பர்கள் உரிமை எடுத்துக்கொள்வதை எந்த வகையிலும் தடுக்காத நட்பே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essence of long-standing friendship, termed here as intimacy. It asks what constitutes such a bond, and answers that it is a friendship that never rejects or resents the liberties taken by the friend. The word 'கீழ்ந்திடா' literally means not tearing or breaking, illustrating that true friends do not let the exercise of familiar privileges damage their relationship.
